summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gains the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members from the spec; botocore/args.py gains ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults and the STS predicate now accepts a None endpoint config; tests/unit/test_args.py gains TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (26 tests). Verified: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py, and test_regions.py pass (415 tests) with the prepared venv. Nothing committed. Choices: absent SDK::Endpoint is returned as None with the key present; FIPS/DualStack falsy results become False via "or False". One pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (the S3 us-east-1 config error raise) was left untouched.
